youtube_description:
Jesus... I stopped texting first for a day. Nobody checked on me. 💔

She stopped texting first for one day to see who would notice. Nobody did.

She: Jesus... I stopped texting first for a day. Nobody checked on me. 💔

Jesus: You were hoping someone would prove you matter.

She: Does nobody noticing mean nobody loves me?

Jesus: It means they got comfortable being carried. It still hurts.

She: So do I just stop trying?

Jesus: Keep being you. And tell one friend: I miss being asked too.

Jesus: I've never once been too tired to reach for you first.

“Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!”
Isaiah 49:15 (BSB)
